protocol: Nested Leave-One-Battery-Out; inner group validation and early stopping only; outer labels never used to tune hyperparameters.
selection_rule: One inner MAE standard error set; lowest violation rate, worst-battery MAE, RMSE, absolute bias, MAE. No absolute pp cutoffs.
promotion_rule: Strict improvement in MAE AND RMSE versus persistence, historical mean, legacy raw AND legacy served on EVERY battery; four evaluable folds and zero future temporal violations. Pilot scope only.
scope: Previously studied four-cell cohort; no untouched external EV validation; cycle rows are correlated, not independent samples.
